content: Bio-copper based dual-action mold inhibitor. The Growing Demand for Eco-Friendly Fungal Control in Modern Storage In today’s feed industry, factors like moisture entry, extended storage times, and inconsistent raw material quality frequently trigger fungal growth and the development of harmful toxins. These conditions not only threaten feed safety and deplete vital nutrients but also directly impact animal performance and health. With the global shift towards antibiotic-free and residue- free production, there is an urgent need for sustainable, plant-based solutions that manage mold effectively and naturally. Challenges Treated doesn't mean gone; silent mold growth is a lingering threat to feed safety. Incomplete suppression: a silent invitation for mold to continue its damage. Silent spread, serious risk: partial mold control is a hidden threat to feed safety. Limited effectiveness against toxin-producing molds A dual-action mold inhibitor with MaxDmold biocopper chelate + natural quinolinol for effective mold control. ACTIVITY AGAINST PATHOGENS Pathogen MaxDmold S. typhi 15 E. coli 18 P. aeruginosa 16 C Sporogens 16 A. Niger 23 C. albicans 15 Mode of Action Cell Membrane Disruption – Plant phytoactives destabilize fungal cell walls, leading to leakage and cell death. Metabolic Interference – Inhibits key enzymatic pathways required for mold growth & replication. Oxidative Stress Modulation – Polyphenols induce Reactive metabolite : Half-chelate oxidative imbalance within fungal cells. Mineral-Stabilised Action – Bioactive copper enhances persistence & uniform activity across feed matrices.
